bullets: Make AI Underwriter easier to set up. Understand how teams configure appetite, underwriting requirements and program behavior; prioritize improvements that reduce friction and…
Improve AI Underwriter through feedback. Turn underwriter corrections, CS feedback and configuration issues into clear problems, proposed changes and validated improvements.
Own product decisions in your area. Work daily with Engineering and Design, test assumptions, write clear requirements and acceptance criteria, and make practical scope calls.
Make improvement repeatable. Define how feedback is captured and configuration changes are reviewed, approved and validated so teams can keep improving AI Underwriter reliably.
Measure what improves. Track days from contract to first production case, configuration accuracy and lines live per customer. Use implementation cycle time, CS tickets and…
Set the P&C vision and roadmap. Prioritize across submission decisioning, program setup and tuning, and Portfolio Intelligence with clear customer and business outcomes.
Own the underwriter experience as a player-coach. Work daily with Engineering and Design, test assumptions, make scope calls and ship useful improvements.
Stay close to customers. Speak with underwriters, program owners and portfolio leaders; show how their feedback changes product decisions.
Own the outcome, including after launch. Establish baselines and improve time to decision, decision quality and adoption. Connect underwriter corrections and customer outcomes to…
Coach two PMs. Help them sharpen discovery, delivery and judgment, and increase their ability to own outcomes independently.

roles.title: VP, Product
roles.location: New York, New York, United States

bullets: Set the direction for what AI-native underwriting looks like at Sixfold, and hold a 12-month theme even as the tactics under it change frequently
Build the first version of new ideas yourself: a prototype, a working demo, a lighthouse customer test, before asking the team to build the tenth
Stay current enough on AI’s leading edge to have a real opinion on where things are going, not just what’s already shipped
Represent Sixfold’s view of where underwriting is headed with customers, partners, and the industry, so people outside the company measure their own thinking against yours
Take ownership of the existing product and team and raise the bar on how they operate, without mistaking "it’s not broken" for "it’s finished"
